Flow.description:
To set 3 reminders for compliance cases to be actioned within the agreed SLA by the contact center based on the agreed time frame provided by the compliance team to avoid any delay.
The 1st and the 2nd reminder will go directly to the assigned users on the FloD queue to remind them to action the case (regardless of case nature).
Tastly, a 3rd reminder will be triggered for the same users plus the Head of contact center & Head of Customer service to follow up.
Flow.label: Compliance Cases - Contact Center Reminders

start.filterLogic: 1 AND (2 OR 3 OR 4 OR 5 OR 6 OR 7)
